body_markdown:
Porsche badge? Tick. Pop-up lights? Tick. Pasha interior? Tick. Transaxle gearbox? Tick. Shooting brake body??? Tick!


The GT-K44 by Germany’s[CarPoint](https://www.carpoint.de/en/gt-k44) has the lot, and it’s a delightful departure from the numerous 911 restomods out there.


Andreas Freund, who founded CarPoint, had previously driven a 1980s Porsche 924 Turbo Brake from Günter Artz and decided to bring the idea back, but with the extra oomph and squatter stance of the 944. Together with designer Michael Söhngen, he set about extending the roofline of the classic 944, adding new rear side windows and a tailgate. The rear quarter panels are also new, and there’s definitely some BMW Z3M[Clown Shoe](https://www.hagerty.com/media/buying-and-selling/hagerty-marketplace/admit-it-youre-bmw-clown-shoe-curious/) influence going on.


CarPoint


That’s a good thing, mind, and all the metalwork has paid off with a distinctive new profile that looks like it could have come from the factory. The Oak Green paintwork is glorious, and the perfect contrast to the classic black-and-white Pasha cabin. Don’t forget there are usable rear seats in the 944, and now the trunk space is even more generous.


CarPoint


CarPoint


Under the hood of CarPoint’s first car is the big three-liter four-cylinder, offering up a healthy 211 hp. CarPoint also suggests that a more potent Turbo would make a decent donor vehicle. The company asks that you provide your car with your chosen engine and transmission combination, but beyond that, it will fit pretty much whatever you want in terms of suspension, brakes, powertrain upgrades, and luxury touches.


“We can’t make it fly, but almost anything else is possible,” says CarPoint.


The cost of conversion starts at around €100,000 or $112,000, while you could pick up a decent donor 944 for less than $30,000, according to Hagerty’s[valuation](https://www.hagerty.com/valuation-tools/porsche/944/1989/1989-porsche-944-s2?id=aCn1I000000CzYMSA0) experts. You may also want to check out our[944 buyer’s guide](https://www.hagerty.com/media/market-trends/your-handy-1982-91-porsche-944-buyers-guide/) before shooting off to purchase.
